found.quote: To reduce the risk of an assessment being compromised, staff are encouraged to reflect carefully on the learning outcomes of the unit, and how these can be assessed.
Guidance on how to reference the use of Gen AI has been produced by the Library.
There are certain indicators that work was not generated by the student, and these are likely to be evident to a human assessor without the use of detection software.
AI will usually offer an ‘average’ response from its available dataset, which will ignore diversity or unorthodox standpoints unless prompted appropriately.

unsure.quote: Students must not claim authorship of any work they did not produce (and must acknowledge any references).
unsure.why: acknowledge references, not clearly AI use

unsure.quote: Staff and students together may consider a range of different tools and instruments
unsure.why: joint discussion in teaching, not governance
